baseline.instructions: Choose one baseline for the repository's image-quality CI only; do not propose a multi-platform matrix.

criteria.ubuntu: Keep the existing pinned Ubuntu24.04 runner and renderer. Existing hosted run succeeded; local Windows development remains independent, no cross-platform CI claim.
criteria.windows: Keep only existing Windows2022 runner. Matches developer OS but hosted setup previously slower; no additional quality coverage from OS match.

evidence_scope.instructions: Which CI reporting scope matches a fully user-rejected batch while validating new image-quality detectors?

criteria.gate_validation: Run positive/negative image-quality controls and reference regressions; explicitly retain all six human verdicts as rejected and report detected defects. More precise results, no blanket art-pass.
criteria.promote_mechanical: Continue green checks on six candidates and treat repeated identical pixels as visual acceptance. Simpler but misses user-rejected pose/identity/eye defects.
criteria.all_tests_all_outputs: Keep all repository tests and redraw every historic sample regardless of affected quality module. Broad coverage but adds cost and can blur the quality evidence.
